requirements.text: The ideal candidate will bring 5+ years of software engineering experience with strong backend expertise (Node.js/NestJS, TypeScript) and solid distributed-systems fundamentals and will be expected to own features end-to-end from requirements through development, QA, and production, lead technical design discussions, and mentor other engineers.
Experience with Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, Go in production, including designing and operating APIs (REST/GraphQL) and relational data models (PostgreSQL).
Strong understanding of distributed systems and micro-service architecture, including experience decomposing or migrating away from monolithic systems.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex features end-to-end, partner with product and cross-functional stakeholders, and deliver high-quality work in a dynamic business environment.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (Master's degree preferred), or equivalent practical experience.
Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth, cross-functional environment.
Experience using Node.js, Go, GraphQL, AWS products, Redis, and React.
Master's degree in Computer Science or additional training in distributed systems or software architecture.
Prior experience in fintech, insurance, or real estate technology.
